item.title: Toba Aquarium: Home of Japan's Only Dugong — Guide
item.description: Toba Aquarium, on the pearl-fishing coast of Toba, is one of Japan’s largest and most beloved aquariums, home to around 1,200 species — one of the highest counts in the country — displayed across twelve themed zones with no fixed route, so visitors wander freely. Its greatest celebrity is Serena, the only dugong on public display anywhere in Japan, joined by playful sea otters, capybaras, rare finless porpoises and a giant spider-crab tank.
